Marcus / Jane —

Initial triage (us-east):
- We've observed an elevated ratio of full model KV lookups (misses) for hot prefixes starting ~10:03 UTC. This aligns with increased latency and error windows.
- The prefix snapshot reconciliation job (snapshot-collector-v2) failed an incremental sync at 09:58 UTC and retried; the retry path missed several short-lived prefixes. That resulted in a 'snapshot-gap' between the serving prefix index and the latest snapshot.
- Symptoms: requests that used to hit the prefix cache now fell back to cold KV lookups; this drove both p95 and p99 upwards and caused occasional 504s when KV backend TTLs were exhausted.

Immediate actions executed:
1) Triggered a manual snapshot reconciliation for us-east and forced a full index merge.
2) Bumped hot-prefix TTLs from 45s -> 300s to reduce cold lookups while we stabilize.
3) Started a warmup job to prefill top 1k prefixes based on recent traffic.

I'm attaching the runbook and the warmup script. Next step: monitor p95/p99 and error rates for 30 minutes, then roll a targeted fix to snapshot-collector to avoid the retry gap.

Attachments: runbook_prefix_snapshot.pdf, warmup-script.sh

Monica Patel
SRE Lead, Runtime
monica.patel@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: sudden latency spike — urgent

Quick operational update — executed mitigations at 10:35 UTC:
- Manual reconciliation completed: snapshot merge OK (merged snapshot id: snap-20261101-1034).
- Hot-prefix TTLs increased; warmup for top prefixes started and 92% primed within 6 minutes.
- Deployed temporary routing rule to route requests for the most impacted model variant to a warmed pool in a neighboring availability zone as fallback.

Observed impact (10:35 -> 10:55 UTC):
- P95 dropped from 900ms -> ~180ms
- P99 dropped from 2.6s -> ~650ms
- Error rate reduced from 4.7% -> 0.9% (still tracking tail failures)

I'll open a JIRA ticket to track the persistent fix: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-9124

Subject: Exec summary + proposed remediation plan for Hearth & Home impact

Laura — looping you in per Jane's request for an exec ETA and to engage CS/finance on potential credits. Summary below for your awareness and any guidance on customer communications: 

Issue summary:
- Root cause: intermittent snapshot-collector retry path created a reconciliation gap ("snapshot-gap") between the serving prefix index and the latest snapshots, causing widespread prefix cache misses for hot keys.
- Manifestation: sudden increase in P95/P99 and error spikes (checkout latency/regressions) for Hearth & Home in us-east.
- Immediate mitigations performed by SRE: manual reconciliation, TTL bump, warmup, and fallback routing. Substantial improvement observed; residual tail still present for a small set of prefixes.

Proposed timeline:
- Short-term (next 24h): backport fix to snapshot-collector to remove retry-gap, add a reconciliation alert, and expand warmup to top 5k prefixes. (owner: Monica)
- Medium-term (2–3 weeks): harden collector retry logic, add a checksum-based validation step to prevent gaps, and add end-to-end canary that exercises prefix reconciliation on deploys. (owner: Infra/Monica)
- Customer communications: propose a short post-mortem (1–2 page) and an offer to discuss service credit. Recommend we have CS own the credit discussion once legal/finance weigh in.

Attachments: runbook_prefix_snapshot.pdf, link to JIRA INF-9124

Update — permanent fix rolled at 08:45 UTC (2026-11-02):
- Deployed collector fix that prevents the retry-path from skipping incremental snapshot segments.
- Added reconciliation healthcheck that alerts at 0.5% snapshot drift.
- Warmup extended to top 5k prefixes; primed successfully.

Current metrics (09:20 UTC):
- P95: 110ms (baseline ~120ms)
- P99: 260ms (baseline ~250–300ms)
- Error rate: 0.1%
